classifications.rationale: The President mandates reinstatement of a policy whose requirements are to be imposed through later agency administration of foreign assistance; the segment does not itself apply an individual funding consequence.
classifications.evidence: reinstate the Presidential Memorandum of January 23, 2017

classifications.rationale: The President directs the Secretary of State to implement specified funding restrictions through later executive-agency action.
classifications.evidence: to ensure that U.S. taxpayer dollars do not fund organizations or programs that support or participate in the management of a program of coercive abortion or involuntary sterilization
